topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I just can't believe this. I come home from a long day, and where's my car? Gone. From my own driveway. That's right, it's been towed. I don't know who decided this was okay or what rule I supposedly broke, but I'm not buying it. My car has been parked here every single day, no issues. Now, I'm stuck dealing with the mess of trying to find it, paying ridiculous fees to get it back, and sorting out whatever absurd misunderstanding led to this. I've got better things to do than chase after my own property. This is just—this is completely unacceptable. I need answers, and I need them now.
